comment: Dr. Meyers helped me with chemistry during my freshman year, and sparked my love of science for the rest of my college career. He will always be remembered as a part of the UR family

Dr. Myers is the epitome of a fantastic college professor. It's actually mind-blowing how good this guy is. Dr. Myers is easily one of the smartest men I've met, he is super friendly, and his lectures couldn't be better. Very communicative, can be easily reached through email, always helpful, and well-prepared for class every time without fail.
He is going to be one of the most memorable professors. He brought Chemistry to my life again. He lighted up my passion again....Great man! I respect him as my grandpa.
Dr. Myers is really helpful and clear!
Dr. Myers is amazing! Take him for chem 141!
He is the best!

Professor Myers was a really good teacher and taught in a way that helped you to learn the subjects rather than memorize at all. Very easy teacher if you simply do 3 or 4 old tests the night before the test and understand the questions in them.

Professor Myers was hands down my favorite professor of my first semester at UR. He is really nice, helpful, and funny! As long as you work hard you will do fine. Study those online tests and see him during office hours

Absolutely great teacher, and an even better guy. His course is difficult, however. Much harder than the other Chem 141 classes. You must be willing to put in a lot of work, especially if you never took AP chem. I was getting murdered early, and worked very hard to salvage a good grade. I learned more in this class than any of my others, however.

Dr. Myers is  a WONDERFUL teacher! He really tries hard to make class interesting and I am coming away from his class with a much better and thorough comprehension of chemistry. His tests and assignments are definitely doable and he always offers help session multiple times a week for anyone needing them. Take his class if possible!
Dr. Myers is awesome! He made me fall in love with this subject again! :) He is a little strict but as long as you study hard, you will be ok. And his old tests online really helped a lot!
Dr. Myers is tough, but extremely helpful. If you put forth the effort in his class you will do well. Really great guy and funny too.

Dr. Myers is an amazing and genuine man with a heart of gold. His class isn't easy, but its chemistry so don't expect it to be. He is more than happy to help you if you're struggling. He holds help sessions weekly (go to them). His teaching style isn't for everyone, but his stories are amusing. WIth effort, you should have no trouble passing

Loved Myers! Yes, the class is difficult, but if you pay attention in class, take notes, actually put effort into the problem sets, and utilize the old practice tests....you are guaranteed to do well! Class was always interesting and I gained a greater appreciation for chem after taking this class!

Myers is great! He challenges his students which may be frustrating at first but it allows you to understand the material at a much deeper level. He also has so many stories that make learning the material much more enjoyable and his study sessions are extremely helpful. I would definitely take his class again!

If you use the old tests that he has on his website you will do well in his class. Take adequate notes during lecture and attend his study sessions if you're confused. He's a fairly lenient grader and will give you points for attempting problems! I really enjoyed his class.

Myers expects you to study and work hard to receive a passing grade. Make sure to use the book and his website with old tests to study and you'll do great. I recommend taking him if you actually want to be brilliant!

Myers expects you to study and work hard to receive a passing grade. Make sure to use his site with old tests to study and you'll do great. I recommend taking him if you actually want to learn the stuff!

Nice guy with very interesting stories pertaining to chemistry.  Difficult teacher though who does not explain many concepts as in-depth as you need for the tests.  Review sessions helped me learn the concepts better.

Myers is a tough teacher, but he really does try to help you through your confusion. He's stories are always entertaining, but you sometimes miss the reason for them. All in all he's a great person and really tries to help you understand the material. If you pick him as a teacher,make sure you get a tutor to even out the rough edges
He saved me in chem. He took the time to teach the material. He only really gives out B and B+ but it is worth it

This class was very unhelpful. He gives problemsets about every other class and a lot of the times he doesn't explain the technique to solving the problemsets even though it's a grade. He tells stories, but they generally don't make sense and the class could go much quicker and easier without them. Save yourself the grief and take the other teacher
Oops below i messed up on my helpfulness rating!
His test are definitely difficult but he puts in the time to help you learn and understand.  Go to ALL of the review sessions, class, and study all of the notes and old test and you will do well.

Is he difficult? Sure. But his lectures are totally entertaining- he's got humorous insights into alot of concepts that other teachers I've had just glaze over. It's refreshing to be in a science class where I'm not falling asleep or choking on my own saliva from boredome.
He is a great teacher. Lectures are interesting and he expects you to be at all of them and pay attention. Very hard grader, but worth it for the MCATs
absolutely awful.  his "help" was confusing.  i wish goldman was there to save me.
loved how he made us all feel stupid for not knowing coulombs law...yeah that was definitely our fault
ummm CONFUSING!  what kind of person would think this guy was any good? sorry i don't have everything from 141 seared in my brain

He is HARD. In the end, however, it is worth taking his class as he forces you to learn the information. I complained about the difficulty of his classes until I took the MCAT. I got almost all the questions right on the material that he covered. He forces you to learn information in much more depth than is normally required.

Best lecturer in the Chem Department. He's very energetic and you leave every class feeling the same energy for the subject. He's hard, so pre-med kids with little interest in chem might not like him, but he's great for anyone else with interest in the subject.
he is a very good teacher. as long as you don't procrastinate and keep up with class notes; you'll do fine. if you fail his class, it's really you...
dr myers is great! very helpful. i don't think he's as hard as people say he is. study, and you'll do fine. the final was a little rough, but the class was well worth it. highly recommended!
Random and sometimes funny stories that seem to have nothing to so with chem, that he somehow makes work.  Not easy, but still highly reccommended!
myers is totally incomprehensible and makes you feel stupid.  i can't believe i paid money for this class.  he's useless.

Yeah he might be entertaining...but when you get the test you realize that all his dumb bs stories didn't quite explain something like d-orbital splitting with the depth he demands...you just sit in class and piles of information flow over you.

Myers knows his stuff, however he will present it in the most convoluded way possible.  Exams will have large amounts of Chem 141 minutae on them, b/c he expects you to have remembered EVERYTHING from two years ago.  If you go for help, you will get the same unhelpful musings and bizarre examples.  Take Goldman for your sanity.
This man gets so excited about chemistry that you have to get excited about it as well. He's a hard grader but he'll teach you lots. Highly recommended.
Dr. Myers is an awesome professor.  He is hard, but you definately learn in his class!
he will do his share and if you do yours, you will be fine and do well.  a very good teacher.
A really hard teacher, who moves very very quickly, but also definitely very helpful, especially if you go after hours to see him. Overall, worth the work!
No Comments
Definitely one of the hardest professors I encountered at Richmond, but an amazing teacher who definitely knows what he's talking about
One of the best profs I ever had in my undergrad or grad chemistry career.  THE reason I became a chemist.
No Comments

A really hard teacher.  Knows more about chemistry than anyone I've ever met, but sometimes it seems like its difficult for him to relate this down to beginning chemistry students. Completing his class prepares very well for next level chemistry classes
